Name: Rest and Recover - Sitting Actions
Author: PanKoziolek
Description:
[size=6]🪑 Sitting Actions[/size]
Addon for Rest and Recover
[b]Interact with the world without leaving your seat.[/b]
Sitting Actions expands [b]Rest and Recover[/b] by allowing your farmer to perform selected actions while sitting on chairs, benches, sofas, and other compatible furniture.
⚠️ [b]Requires Rest and Recover 1.4.6 or later.[/b]
This add-on does not work on its own.
[heading][size=5]✨ Features[/size][/heading]
✔ Talk to nearby NPCs
✔ Watch television
✔ Use supported furniture and objects
✔ Eat and drink while seated
✔ Read books, Secret Notes, and Journal Scraps
✔ Choose the exact NPC or object you want to interact with
✔ Remain seated after supported actions
✔ Configurable through Generic Mod Config Menu
✔ English and Polish localization
[heading][size=5]📏 Interaction Range[/size][/heading]
You can interact with targets up to [b]4 tiles in front[/b] and [b]1 tile to either side[/b]. Objects behind the player are ignored.
[heading]⚙ Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+ [/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+ [/*]
[*]Rest and Recover 1.4.6+ [/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu — optional [/*]
[/list][heading]📥 Installation[/heading]
Install Rest and Recover, extract Sitting Actions into the
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder, and launch the game through SMAPI.
Sit down, relax, and interact with the world around you.
[heading][size=5]❤️ Feedback[/size][/heading]
Bug reports and suggestions for new seated interactions are welcome. Please include your SMAPI log and installed mod versions when reporting a problem.

[size=3]❤️ Special Thanks[/size]
[size=2]I’d like to thank member carpophorus for suggesting the idea that inspired me to create Sitting Actions.[/size]
